welcome.title: Your next journey starts here
welcome.subtitle: Upload your ticket and let Yola plan the rest.

language.title: Language
language.subtitle: Choose the app language
language.restartMessage: The app will restart to change the text direction.

auth.signInSubtitle: We'll email you a 6-digit sign-in code. No password needed.
auth.codeSubtitle: Type the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}.
auth.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Try again.
auth.guestHint: Your data stays on this phone. You can create an account any time.
auth.notConfigured: The server connection isn't set up yet. You can continue without an account for now.

onboarding.companionSubtitle: I'll pick routes, pace and places to match.
onboarding.budgetSubtitle: Food, stays and activity suggestions change with it.
onboarding.interestsSubtitle: Pick at least one. You can change this later in your profile.

companion.solo_desc: Flexible pace, hostels and social spots
companion.couple_desc: Romantic evenings, places with a view

budget.mid_desc: Good-value hotels, local restaurants, a few paid activities
budget.lux_desc: Boutique hotels, fine dining, private tours

today.noTripDescription: Upload your flight ticket or hotel booking and I'll sketch out your trip.
today.featureReplan: Rain, delays, tired feet: it changes the plan on the spot.
today.featureOffline: Your route and tickets stay with you, even offline.
today.featureMenu: Snap a menu to learn what each dish is and how pricey it is.

trips.title: My trips
trips.emptyUpcomingDescription: Upload a ticket or hotel booking to create your first trip.
trips.emptyPastDescription: When a trip ends, its summary and ratings will appear here.

social.title: Traveler matching
social.subtitle: Grab a coffee or explore together with travelers in the same city, always in a public place.
social.safetyLocation: Your location is shown to within about 1 km. Your exact spot is never shared.
social.safetyPublic: Meetups can only be suggested at public places like museums and cafés.
social.safetyBlock: You can block and report anyone.
social.safetyWomen: You can choose to match only with women travelers.

profile.title: Profile
profile.guestNote: Create an account to keep your trips on all your devices.

assistant.title: Change the plan
assistant.subtitle: What happened? I'll suggest something new based on where you are and your plan.
assistant.placeholder: e.g. It started raining, find somewhere indoors nearby
assistant.suggestionRain: It's raining, find an indoor place within 1 km
assistant.suggestionDelay: My train is delayed, I have 2 hours to fill
assistant.suggestionTired: I'm tired, suggest a quiet café nearby
assistant.suggestionBudget: I'm over budget today, suggest something free
assistant.notReady: Got it: "{{message}}". The AI assistant gets connected in step 6; then I'll give real suggestions based on your location.
assistant.thinking: Looking at your location and plan…
assistant.noTrip: You don't have a trip in progress, so suggestions are general.

ticket.title: Upload ticket or hotel
ticket.subtitle: Upload a screenshot or PDF and let AI read departure, arrival, dates and hotel details.
ticket.supported: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC · up to 10 MB · you can pick several
ticket.accountRequiredBody: You need an account so your documents can be stored safely and read by AI.
ticket.serverMissingBody: Document reading runs on the server. The server and AI keys get connected in step 15; until then this screen can pick documents but can't read them.

errors.permission_denied: Camera access was denied. You can allow it in your phone's settings.
errors.unsupported_file: This file type isn't supported. Upload a PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.quota_exceeded: You've used all document scans on the free plan.
errors.ai_failed: AI couldn't read the document. Try again with a sharper photo.
errors.no_reservations: No reservation details were found in this document.
errors.network: Connection error. Check your internet and try again.

review.title: Check the details
review.subtitle: Check what AI read. It isn't sure about the fields marked in yellow.

trip.planSoon: The day-by-day route arrives in step 5.

plan.title: Route
plan.emptyBody: I'll plan each day hour by hour around your bookings, matched to your budget, travel companions and interests.
plan.generating1: Picking places that fit your budget…
plan.generating3: Checking opening hours and travel times…
plan.generatingHint: This can take about a minute.
plan.truncated_one: On the free plan only the first {{count}} day is planned. Pro plans every day.
plan.truncated_other: On the free plan only the first {{count}} days are planned. Pro plans every day.

errors.quota_exceeded: You've used all route builds for this trip.
errors.ai_failed: Couldn't build the route. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_configured: The server isn't configured yet. The AI connection is set up in step 15.
errors.no_dates: This trip has no start and end dates.
errors.network: Connection error. Check your internet and try again.

dates.title: Change dates
dates.subtitle: Make your trip shorter or longer. Your bookings are never deleted.
dates.uncovered: You need a place to stay: no hotel booking for the nights of {{list}}.
dates.highlights: I'll try to fit these highlights from the removed days into the remaining days: {{list}}
dates.nothingRemoved: Nothing was removed from the plan.

versions.title: Plan history
versions.subtitle: Every change is saved as a new version. You can go back to any of them.
versions.compare: Differences from the plan in use
versions.noDiff: Same as the plan in use.

nearby.title: Open near you now
nearby.locationDenied: Allow location access to see places open near you.
nearby.empty: Nothing open nearby in this category right now.

errors.quota_exceeded: You've used today's free searches. Upgrade for unlimited searches.
errors.upstream_failed: Couldn't load places. Please try again.

map.openRoute: Open the route in Google Maps

place.closedPermanently: Permanently closed — consider replacing this stop
place.closedTemporarily: Temporarily closed — check before you go

hotels.title: Hotel suggestions
hotels.empty: No hotels found for this budget.
hotels.disclosure: Yola may earn a commission if you book through these links. Your price stays the same.
